meta.provenance_note: Read directly from the PDF via PyMuPDF on 2026-09-17 — same source and treatment as iqra_curriculum_g4_english_sem1.json. Units are numbered 6-10, continuing Semester 1's 1-5, matching the book's own contents page (Welcome 'Hello from Hamed!' plus units printed '5 Hobbies' through '8 Let's celebrate!').
known_gaps: 2026-09-19 verification: this file's unit-level content (unit titles/order, vocabulary lists, grammar rules with the book's own example sentences, and 'Listening' skill descriptors) was checked page by page against the book's own Scope and sequence table (pp. 4-5) and against the unit body pages themselves ('Hello from Hamed!' pp. 6-9 in full; spot checks of Units 7-10's vocabulary/grammar pages) — every item matches the book verbatim, and nothing is invented or missing at this level.

That same check confirms this file's lesson-level granularity is coarser than the book's own page layout, in exactly the same pattern as iqra_curriculum_g4_english_sem1.json (see its known_gaps for the full rationale): 'Hello from Hamed!' has 'Lesson 1'-'Lesson 3' printed inside it, and every other unit has 8 lessons numbered 1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 8, 9, 10 (Vocabulary / Story / Grammar / Vocabulary and Grammar / Culture / English in Action / Reading / Writing), skipping 4 and 6. Deliberately left unreconstructed here too, for the same reasons (rebuild-scale, breaks consistency with sibling grades' English catalogs, no hardcoded id dependents found in this repo).

The scope-and-sequence table's 'Listening' column is the only skill descriptor captured in each unit's second ('Listening & Speaking') lesson; the table also carries Speaking / Reading / Writing / Phonics / Project / Viewing-and-presenting / Functions columns (book pp. 4-5) that are not represented anywhere in this file. 'Listening & Speaking' is this catalog's own umbrella label — the book itself never prints that combined heading.

'Hello from Hamed!' (the review unit opening this semester) is a revision unit: the scope-and-sequence table gives no itemized vocabulary list for it (just 'Revision of vocabulary from Grade 4 Semester 1'), so its Vocabulary & Grammar lesson's vocabulary array is empty.

Excluded as supplementary, non-core material (no dedicated row in the scope-and-sequence table): the 'Bo's Learning Club: Language booster 2' spread, the 'Social Studies: What was transport like 100 years ago?' page, the 'Festivals' pages (World Wildlife Day, Eid al-Adha, International Literacy Day), 'Solve it', and the 'Grammar reference' appendix.
